title: 2007 AMC 12B Problem 15
statement: The geometric series \(a+ar+ar^2+\cdots\) has a sum of \(7,\) and the terms involving odd powers of \(r\) have a sum of \(3.\) What is \(a+r?\)

solutions.text:
The odd-power terms are \(ar+ar^3+\cdots\) \(=r(a+ar^2+\cdots),\) that is, \(r\) times the even-power terms. The even-power terms sum to \(7-3=4.\)

So \(3=4r,\) giving \(r=\tfrac34.\) Then \(a=7(1-r)=\tfrac74,\) and \[ a+r=\dfrac74+\dfrac34=\dfrac52. \]

Thus, the correct answer is E.
hints: The odd-power series is \(r\) times the even-power series, so \(3=r\cdot4\)
